_meta.description: Workload-to-Rubric semantic map. Tells Stage 2 evaluators how to interpret a candidate's background against the target vertical's current industry maturity. Used by the orchestrator to select the correct evaluation persona and scoring rubric before a credit is spent.
_meta.source: RISC-V International Annual Report 2025 + CVE internal intelligence

automotive.maturity_stage: accelerating — Infineon committed full MCU roadmap to RISC-V in March 2025
automotive.headline_signal: Infineon announced full automotive MCU roadmap on RISC-V; Automotive SIG actively defining MCU profile (RVM) and Functional Safety (FuSa) standards
automotive.candidate_thesis: Prioritize engineers with ISO 26262 / ASIL experience and automotive MCU background. Tricore (Infineon), S32 (NXP), RH850 (Renesas) engineers have 100% portable domain knowledge — their ISA is changing, their safety framework and customer relationships are not.

data_center.maturity_stage: deployment beginning — first RISC-V cloud instances live (Scaleway 2025); Server SoC spec ratified
data_center.headline_signal: Scaleway launched first public RISC-V cloud instances. Server SoC 1.0, BRS, RPMI 1.0, SBI 3.0 all ratified. Canonical targeting RVA23-only builds. RISC-V Server Platform spec expected ratification end of 2026.
data_center.candidate_thesis: Prioritize server platform architects, hypervisor engineers, and firmware engineers (UEFI/ACPI/Redfish). ACPI 6.6 added native RISC-V support in May 2025 — engineers with ACPI/UEFI background are now a direct funnel. ARM Neoverse engineers are high-value transition targets.

hpc.maturity_stage: pilot programs — NVIDIA CUDA porting to RISC-V; EuroHPC DARE initiative launched with €120M
hpc.headline_signal: NVIDIA announced CUDA support for RISC-V (catalyzed by RVA23 ratification). EuroHPC DARE initiative (€120M, coordinated by Barcelona Supercomputing Center) runs to 2030. ~1/3 of supercomputer application runtime now ported to RISC-V.
hpc.candidate_thesis: CUDA software engineers are a new direct funnel — NVIDIA explicitly stated RVA23 ratification triggered the CUDA decision. HPC SW engineers with OpenMP, MPI, or BLAS/LAPACK optimization background are high-value transitions. Vector/matrix extension (RVV, AME) expertise is the differentiating signal.

iot_embedded.maturity_stage: mature — strongest deployed base; RVB23 ratified end of 2024; RVM MCU profile in progress
iot_embedded.headline_signal: RVB23 ratified. RVM MCU profile draft available; ratification expected 2026. RISC-V / Edge AI Foundation partnership announced at Summit NA 2025. Google open-sourced Coral/Kelvin NPU on RISC-V.
iot_embedded.candidate_thesis: Established talent pool. Focus on edge AI differentiation: candidates who can run scalar + vector + AI inference on a single RISC-V core (eliminating memory copies vs. separate NPU). Load/Store Pair ratification (Jan 2025) is a signal for power-sensitive embedded work.

space.maturity_stage: emerging — first RISC-V In Space conference April 2025; NASA HPSC SoC update; radiation-hardened IP completing verification
space.headline_signal: First RISC-V In Space conference (ESA + Frontgrade Gaisler, Sweden, April 2025). NASA HPSC SoC: 10-core heterogeneous RISC-V (SiFive + Microchip). Frontgrade Gaisler NOEL-V radiation-hardened core completed verification late 2025.
space.candidate_thesis: Niche, high-barrier pool. Rad-hard design experience (SEU mitigation, TMR, latch-up hardening) is the primary moat. Candidates from Frontgrade Gaisler, Cobham Gaisler, BAE Systems, or NASA/JPL silicon teams are Tier-1. VHDL fluency is common here (NOEL-V is VHDL-based).

ai_horizontal.maturity_stage: exploding — nearly every new AI accelerator project in 2025 using RISC-V; matrix extension standardization in progress
ai_horizontal.headline_signal: Google open-sourced Coral/Kelvin NPU (RISC-V based). NVIDIA CUDA porting to RISC-V. Three competing matrix extension paths (IME/VME/AME) in standardization. RISE AI/ML Working Group formed Feb 2025. Global AI processor revenue projected +50% over 5 years (Omdia).
ai_horizontal.candidate_thesis: AI cuts horizontally — route to vertical-specific evaluator after initial AI signal detected. Key differentiator: candidates who understand scalar+vector+matrix unification on one core (not separate NPU). Software-side: IREE, TVM, llama.cpp, and pytorch RISC-V optimization experience are 2025/2026 hotspots.

security_horizontal.maturity_stage: converging fast — Caliptra 2.1, CHERIoT 1.0, CoVE progressing to ratification; £21M UK funding for CHERIoT silicon
security_horizontal.headline_signal: Caliptra 2.1 released (quantum-resilient RoT, OCP Global Summit Oct 2025). CHERIoT 1.0 spec released; £21M UK funding for SCI Semiconductor CHERIoT Kudu silicon. CoVE + CoVE-IO progressing through community review. OpenTitan volume production starting (Nuvoton + Google).
security_horizontal.candidate_thesis: Security is now a first-class horizontal, not an afterthought. Two distinct sub-tracks: (1) Hardware security IP engineers — TEE, RoT, Supervisor Domains, IOPMP; (2) Security architects who understand the threat model and can apply RISC-V's modular ISA to build isolation-by-design systems. The second type is rare and commands a premium.
